label: Buchanan Lake northwestern lake/stream junction
point_definition: Northwestern stream meets the upper-west lake shore, distinct from the separate western connection farther south.
identity_evidence: The long east-west Buchanan basin, separate northwest and west water connections, northern/eastern tributaries and road along the north side distinguish the feature. The native crop resolves the upper-west shoreline turn and the northwest approach, with a short ink gap at their convergence. The lower west connection is a different node. Modern original WARV50 and WALK20 segments share the selected coordinate. The lake name identifies locality only; neither the namepoint nor a whole-basin centroid was used. McIntyre Lake and its earlier R31 junction are separate features to the west.
phase: Untouched fresh physical validation after the affine14 freeze; excluded from fitting and model selection
